intro: Sawtooth Industrial Systems coordinates build-to-print control panel fabrication and mission-critical component sourcing from Boise, Idaho.

general.about: Sawtooth Industrial Systems provides direct owner accountability backed by 12+ years of electrical wholesale distribution and industrial logistics experience. We eliminate bureaucratic conglomerate delays by coordinating certified UL 508A manufacturing facilities across the Intermountain West.

process.title: 1. Schematic & BOM Intake
process.desc: Send us your CAD schematics, one-line diagrams, or bill of materials. Direct owner engineering review within 24 to 48 hours.

process.title: 2. Sourcing & Supplement SB Optimization
process.desc: We cross-reference long-lead components with verified equivalents, preserving UL 508A high-fault SCCR ratings while cutting lead times from 40 weeks to days.

process.title: 3. Certified Partner Fabrication & FAT
process.desc: Panels are precision-machined, busbar-formed, and wired through certified UL 508A shops with 100% point-to-point continuity, megger, and dielectric testing.

process.title: 4. Job-Site Delivery & Traveler Sign-Off
process.desc: Delivered with serialized UL 508A listing labels, complete submittal packages, and standard 12-month panel workmanship warranties.

industrial.benefits: Bypass 50 to 90+ week conglomerate delays with fast-track 8 to 12 week panel delivery cadence.
industrial.painPoints: Factory backorders, multi-tier distributor runarounds, and uncoordinated component bottlenecks delaying plant commissioning.
industrial.solution: Direct access to the procurement lead, local Boise job-site support, and verified Sparks NV logistics pipelines.

diversity.benefits: 100% dollar-for-dollar Tier-1 and Tier-2 diversity spend credit on federal and enterprise prime contracts.
diversity.painPoints: Prime EPCs struggling to fulfill FAR 19.7 small business subcontracting goals with qualified technical suppliers.
diversity.solution: Accredited Northwest Mountain MSDC Certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) with active CAGE (9Z4A2) and SAM.gov registrations.
